propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep spawns one git log --full-history walk per ticket inside the store write lock, blocking all writers for minutes and causing observed 24+ minute lock holds and write starvation.
Per-ticket history walk map misses fall through to per-event full-history wildcard walks with leading-wildcard pathspec defeating pruning, making deployed cost worse than one-per-ticket.
The sweep holds the write lock throughout and never re-probes for writer arrival, so a sweep begun on a quiet store does not yield when writers arrive.
Staging via unscoped git add -A sweeps a concurrent writer's uncommitted event files into the compaction commit rather than only the folded paths.
The fix hoists the history walk out of the lock via a single pre-sweep position-keyed commit map built before any lock, queries it per ticket, and re-probes the lock between tickets.
Fallback to per-ticket walk on map build failure is required to avoid worse pathology; the ledger must be byte-identical with and without the prebuilt map.
